description: This file defines data types, enums, structures, and function prototypes for the WDMP (Wireless Device Management Protocol) C library, including request/response handling, status codes, and data models.

methods.name: wdmp_parse_request
methods.description: Converts a JSON payload string into a request structure.

methods.name: wdmp_parse_generic_request
methods.description: Converts a JSON payload string of a specified type into a request structure.

methods.name: wdmp_form_response
methods.description: Converts a response structure into a JSON payload string.

methods.name: wdmp_free_req_struct
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a request structure.

methods.name: wdmp_free_res_struct
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a response structure.

methods.name: mapWdmpStatusToStatusMessage
methods.description: Maps a WDMP_STATUS code to a human-readable status message.
